145: - Real subprocess timeout killed the 30-second fixture with SIGKILL at the production 10-second deadline. Actual output overflow reported ERR_CHILD_PROCESS_STDIO_MAXBUFFER. Missing script failed safely. Fixtures were isolated; production Ada was not replaced.
146: - Python adapter check passed nine invalid inputs, an isolated missing backend, five exact source/line comparisons, and retrieval-only contract assertions. Ada directory hashes and all six approved source content hashes stayed unchanged across the checks. This is observed behavior, not a filesystem sandbox guarantee. No parent symlinks were present for returned sources; source containment and TOCTOU prevention remain unresolved.
147: - Real Electron UI IPC loaded saved Liam and launched Claude with the exact Safe allowlist: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, Bash(wos-gen:*), Bash(wos-action:*). Token/socket presence and cwd were captured without recording the token.
148: - A deterministic child probe through that actual launcher/socket successfully queried evidence, rejected a missing token, denied browser.navigate, and rejected the same token after the workspace context changed. Report: launcher-permissions.json.
149: - Live Claude run succeeded: two turns, CLI-reported models claude-sonnet-5 and claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, cost metadata $0.1719384, code 0. Raw bridge JSON independently extracted and retained in live-bridge-response.json; all five excerpts independently matched their referenced files/lines. answer=null, RETRIEVAL_ONLY and UNRESOLVED preserved.
150: - New live response used the exact sentence from Constitution line 40 as a quotation and labelled subsequent prose as a paraphrase. Retained in live-liam-response.md. This corrects the presentation going forward; old chat history remains historical, not verified quotation evidence.
151: - Missing grant, revoked token, wrong workspace, no open workspace, no authorization dependency, unbound token and legacy all behavior are covered by permission tests. Legacy all access remains available to workspace-bound runs; Liam is not exclusive. memory.search remains an existing baseline permission.
152: - Rollback demonstrated in an isolated source copy using preserved originals, including original profile and adapter removal in the copy; 15 original bridge/grant tests passed. Live files were not rolled back. Repeated using committed recovery archives, not reliance on temporary recovery paths.
153: - Build and macro validation passed. Typecheck: 70 known errors / baseline 75; no new regressions, not type-error-free. git diff --check clean.

155: ### Test harness corrections and launch verification
156: Initial sandbox socket tests failed with EPERM; rerun with socket access passed. An early backup beneath the repository was accidentally discovered as a test suite; it was moved out and archived before the clean run. Live harness initially assumed ~/.local/bin/claude; actual binary is /opt/homebrew/bin/claude. Canonicalized macOS /var versus /private/var paths in the harness. Direct launch of out/main/index.js missed resource installation, causing wos-action command-not-found; corrected to launch the project directory. A first permission probe half-closed its socket too early; fixed to wait for the asynchronous response. These failed harness attempts are not counted as successful acceptance.

158: Verified repeatable launch: `cd ~/Desktop/Workspace-OS && sh scripts/liam-ada/launch.sh`. The script built successfully, loaded Electron native modules and opened the local app using separate `.workspace-os/liam-app-data` and `.workspace-os/liam-workspace`. Updater reported disabled for unpackaged development. Select Liam, Safe, Claude/Sonnet, and start a fresh chat. Detailed instructions and commands: Workspace-OS/docs/liam-ada/README.md.
